name: io.github.NoteSupreme/claude-seo-skills
title: Claude SEO Skills
description: Two open-source SEO skill packs (Claude SEO, Illyism SEO Skills) served read-only to any AI agent.

tools.name: claudeseoskills__read_node
tools.description: Read one node's full markdown body + frontmatter by node_id. Response includes outbound_links[] (resolved graph edges) unless with_links:false, plus source attribution. Pass heading (e.g. "Tactics") to get ONLY that markdown section — a few hundred chars instead of the whole body; every heading read, hit or miss, carries the node's headings list, and a miss is heading_not_found — so a guessed heading is cheap (heading "" just lists the headings). A heading read is partial — never write it back as a node's content; re-read without heading first. A long body is returned one page at a time — when the response says truncated, call again with { cursor } to continue it.

tools.name: claudeseoskills__search_nodes
tools.description: Search nodes by text, node_type, and/or semantic `type`. Token-AND across title + description + tags. Primary retrieval path — use it before reading bodies. Results are ranked best match first — `score` on each row is the match strength (title hits count double). Page 1 is the top of the ranking. A one-word query can match hundreds of rows — put two or more terms in `query` so the top rows are the answer, not a dump. Terms are AND-ed: if two return nothing, drop one. Reports total_matches; when more matches exist than fit in one response, narrow the query or pass { cursor } for the next page (a cursor is only valid for the query that produced it).

tools.name: claudeseoskills__list_ship_nodes
tools.description: List every node: node_id, title, parent_id, node_type, plus type/description/tags/resource when set. No bodies. This is a flat list of the WHOLE Ship — on a large one it is long and arrives in pages, so pass { cursor } to continue. To navigate rather than enumerate, use claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest.

tools.name: claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest
tools.description: Orient on this Ship — ALWAYS call this first. With no arguments it returns the section MAP and nothing else: every top-level section with its description and child_count, which is small and cheap even on a Ship of hundreds of nodes. Then pass { section_id } to list one section's direct children, and claudeseoskills__read_node for the ones worth reading. A large section arrives in pages — continue it with { cursor }.

tools.name: claudeseoskills__get_blueprint_overview
tools.description: Read the human-AUTHORED overview prose for the Ship (omit node_id) or for one section. Useful only where someone has written a summary; it is not the way to navigate — claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest is the map, call that first. When no summary has been written this falls back to the same section map claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest returns, drilled with { section_id } and paged with { cursor }.
